pkgmetadata.longdescription: AutoEq turns a headphone frequency-response measurement and a target curve into equalizer settings: a minimum- or linear-phase impulse response for convolution (EasyEffects .irs, PipeWire), parametric EQ (Equalizer APO / EasyEffects import), fixed-band and graphic EQ. Command: autoeq (or python -m autoeq). Upstream's version pins are relaxed; output verified identical on current numpy/scipy.
